title: hello-cli — the minimal vertical slice (target: cli)

beats.label: Open the starter README
beats.cue: “Smallest possible slice: a spec in, a streaming chat agent out.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed crewhaus.yaml stays untouched.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the run beats.

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “Two lines: what it's called, and which runtime spine to compile.”

beats.label: Add the agent block
beats.cue: “A model and instructions — that's the whole agent.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The spec is sugar; this JSON is what the compiler actually sees.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target cli

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it: GREEN.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “One generated TypeScript file, imports and all — you own the output, not a framework.”

beats.label: Launch the REPL
beats.cue: [needs-key] “crewhaus run compiles in memory and drops into a streaming chat loop.”

beats.label: Ask it something
beats.cue: [needs-key] Two sentences or fewer — the instructions hold.
beats.text: In one sentence: what is a meta-harness?

beats.label: Ask for more detail
beats.cue: [needs-key] “…unless the user asks for more detail.” — it obeys the escape hatch.
beats.text: Now give me more detail, in four sentences.

groups.title: One more thing · the bundle is yours

beats.label: Open the emitted package.json
beats.cue: “Six pinned @crewhaus deps — and --check already resolved them into a bun.lock beside it. That's what makes the bundle yours.”

beats.label: Run the compiled bundle directly
beats.cue: [needs-key] “No CLI in the loop — it's a Bun program that imports @crewhaus/*.”

verify.note: same REPL, booted from the emitted bundle
